English

Etymology

First attested in 1826. From holla and hollo.

Pronunciation

  • /hɛˈloʊ/ US
  • /həˈləʊ/ UK

Interjection

  1. A greeting said when meeting someone.
    Hello, everyone.
  2. A greeting used when answering the telephone.
